newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil under pressure once more.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil under pressure once more.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run was under pressure again on Thursday amid poor demand from refiners preferring the more lucrative processing of crude, traders said.
Offers were heard around $95-$94 fob NWE, in line with yesterday but said likely to come down as availability dates draw near. U.S. interest was pegged around $92 fob.
With the economics of refining crude so attractive, traders said only specific quality material was generating interest.
Russian resid cargoes, still trickling out, were having problems finding buyers. The Talava, an E-4 cargo from Klaipeda, was heard sold on Thursday at a price not known.
Outright prices for E-4 were discussed as around $93-$94 cif, but likely to come off as pricing quotes fall on the back of today's cargo deals in the cracked market.
